svg.desc: 25 Jan 2013–10 Oct 2018. Historical exploratory simulation, not prospective verification. Base checkpoint: net total return 65.101125%; Directional weight edit: net total return 65.101125%; Evolution strategies · seed 42: net total return 62.718415%; Directional edit + ES · seed 42: net total return 62.718415%; Random-direction control: net total return 63.913532%; SPY buy and hold: net total return 107.230902%
